articles.title: Landslide at waste mound in Guinea capital kills 30, government says
articles.highlight: 政府宣布计划关闭并迁走该垃圾场不到一周，暴雨后垃圾山坍塌，吞噬附近帐篷和棚屋。
articles.summary: 几内亚首都科纳克里一座大型垃圾场在连夜暴雨后发生滑坡，造成30人死亡。事发前不到一周，政府刚宣布因威胁而计划关闭该场地并转移垃圾。文章强调西非多座城市在雨季面临山体滑坡和致命洪水的风险，凸显提前防灾的紧迫性。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：官方已认识到垃圾场的雨季威胁，但行动未能赶在灾害之前。城市防灾必须把承诺转化为快速、可执行的搬迁计划，尤其在雨季到来前。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Dump site in Conakry, which minister had just promised to move, collapsed after heavy rain in west African state A ⁠landslide at a huge waste dump in Guinea’s capital has killed 30 people, the government said on Sunday, after heavy rains overnight prompted it to ⁠collapse, engulfing nearby tents and shacks. The incident occurred less than a week after the government announced plans to close the ⁠site and relocate the waste because of the threat it posed, especially during the rainy season, which causes landslides and fatal flash ⁠floods each year in crowded, underdeveloped cities across parts of West Africa.

articles.title: Where Love Goes When It Goes
articles.highlight: 爱消逝时去了哪里？这问题平凡而真诚，在每个破碎之心中轰鸣，回荡于所有文明的恋歌与十四行诗中。
articles.summary: 这篇文章出自《Traversal》，以诗意的哲思追问失恋之爱的去向，指出“爱去了哪里”这一问法本身预设了爱的移动与目的地。文章将个人心碎与文明中的情歌、壁画和涂鸦相连，值得一读，因为它让人重新思考爱的本质与消逝。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：爱并非像物件般离开，而是转化为记忆、书写和创作，持续影响生命。追问爱的去向，本身就是对爱之本质的一次深刻反思。
articles.sourceExcerpt: This is an excerpt from Traversal. Where does love go when it goes? It is a common question, contrived in its commonness yet savagely sincere, bellowing in the bosom of every brokenhearted lover, reverberating through the body of every civilization’s love songs and sonnets, radiating from cave drawings and dive bar graffiti.

articles.summary: 该仓库是同花顺官方发布的A股金融数据服务，旨在为AI Agent、量化研究和应用开发提供实时及历史行情、财务报表等数据。它支持API、MCP、CLI和Python多种调用方式，适合开发者集成。值得关注是因为官方数据源通常更稳定可信，且当前已有1587星标，社区认可度较高。
articles.failureAnalysis: 尽管有官方背景，但A股数据市场已存在多家成熟供应商（如Wind、聚宽、Tushare），竞争激烈且用户切换成本高。若免费额度有限或需要付费订阅，可能难以吸引大量开发者长期使用。此外，依赖同花顺平台可能存在数据延迟、合规限制以及供应商锁定风险，影响项目的持续活跃与商业化变现。

en.summary: This repository is Tonghuashun's official A-share financial data service, aimed at AI agents, quantitative research, and application development. It offers real-time and historical market data, financial statements, and supports API, MCP, CLI, and Python. It is worth reading because official data sources tend to be more reliable, and the project has gained notable community traction with 1,587 stars.
en.failureAnalysis: Despite official backing, competition is intense from established vendors like Wind, JoinQuant, and Tushare, and switching costs are high. Limited free tiers or pricing constraints could hinder adoption, while reliance on Tonghuashun's platform risks latency, regulatory limits, and vendor lock-in.
